# Emma Hall Paintings

> Original oil and watercolour paintings, landscapes, botanicals, portraits, and custom pet portrait commissions by visual artist Emma Hall.

## About the Artist
Emma Hall is a contemporary visual artist born in South India who creates original fine art using palette knife, impasto oil painting, and watercolour techniques. Inspired by her travels across Japan, Italy, Lebanon, India, and the UK, her works capture vivid textures, natural landscapes, and expressive portraiture. Her art has been exhibited and sold internationally in Paris, London, Los Angeles, and Milan.

## Collections & Bodies of Work
- **Botanical & Floral Paintings**: Vibrant oil florals including English roses, sunflowers from Tuscany, Japanese water lilies, and Costa Rican botanicals.
- **Landscape & Travel Paintings**: Palette knife impasto landscapes capturing Venice, Tuscany, Ischia, Kyoto, Tokyo, Lebanon, Indian rivers, and the French countryside.
- **Original Watercolours**: Delicate architectural and landscape watercolours depicting Kyoto temples (Kinkakuji, Gion), shrines, and countryside scenes.
- **Fine Art & Figurative Portraits**: Expressive figurative oil paintings including iconic figures (David Bowie, Celine Dion) and classical master studies.
- **Custom Pet Portraits**: Hand-painted commissioned pet portraits in oil on canvas (dogs, cats, horses) with international shipping.
